decks.notes: This deck focuses on using removal spells and hand disruption to control the game, while also utilizing sacrifice mechanics and life gain to outlast opponents. The key strategy involves disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Grief and Inquisition of Kozilek, then using cards like Soul Spike and Necrodominance to gain advantage and close out the game with powerful creatures like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Boggart Trawler. The deck also has some land destruction elements with cards like Phyrexian Tower and Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth to further disrupt the opponent's resources.

This deck aims to control the game through disruption and removal while ramping up to powerful Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul and Ulamog. It utilizes cards like Ancient Stirrings and Eldrazi Temple to quickly find and cast these threats, while also running board wipes like All Is Dust to clear the way. Through the Breach provides a surprise factor, allowing for a quick, unexpected win. The deck combines control elements with big, game-ending threats to dominate the battlefield and overpower opponents in Modern 1 vs 1 matches.

This Mardu Aggro deck focuses on quick and aggressive creature plays, supported by removal spells like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize. The deck aims to maintain board control with cards like Amped Raptor and Orcish Bowmasters, while also utilizing powerful finishers like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds an additional layer of versatility to the deck. Overall, the strategy revolves around dealing damage fast and efficiently, before the opponent has a chance to stabilize.

This deck focuses on aggressive plays using a combination of creature cards like Amped Raptor, Orcish Bowmasters, and Ocelot Pride, supported by powerful spells like Fatal Push and Galvanic Discharge. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional flexibility and consistency to the deck. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Static Prison and Thoughtseize to control the opponent's resources. The mana base is optimized with a mix of fetch lands and shock lands to ensure smooth mana curve. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with fast and efficient threats.

This Mardu Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creatures and powerful spells to quickly overwhelm opponents. By utilizing cards like Amped Raptor, Guide of Souls, and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury, the deck aims to apply pressure early and consistently. The inclusion of Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Ob Nixilis, the Adversary provides additional flexibility and disruption against opposing strategies. The deck also features a small control package with Fatal Push, Thoughtseize, and Static Prison to handle threats and disrupt opponents' game plans. Ultimately, this deck seeks to maintain tempo and momentum to secure fast victories.

This Mardu Aggro deck focuses on fast and aggressive creature plays, utilizing cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah, Amped Raptor, and Guide of Souls to quickly overwhelm opponents. It also includes disruption spells like Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Discharge to control the board. The deck's key strategy is to maintain pressure on the opponent while using Goblin Bombardment and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury for additional reach and finishers. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds an extra layer of flexibility and consistency to the deck's game plan.

This deck focuses on generating mana quickly through cards like Pyretic Ritual and Manamorphose to cast combo pieces such as Ral, Monsoon Mage and Ruby Medallion. By utilizing cards like Past in Flames and Glimpse the Impossible, the deck aims to chain together spells to create a massive storm count. Wish allows for flexibility in finding necessary pieces while March of Reckless Joy can provide a big burst of damage. The deck also includes utility lands like Sunbaked Canyon and utilizes the companion Jegantha, the Wellspring for additional value.

The main focus of this deck is to establish control over the game by utilizing the powerful UrzaTron lands to ramp up mana quickly and play big threat cards like Thought-Knot Seer, Ulamog, and Karn, the Great Creator. The deck also includes cards like All Is Dust and Ugin's Binding to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. With a mix of ramp, control elements, and high-impact creatures, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize the ramping capabilities of UrzaTron lands (Urza's Mine, Power Plant, and Tower) to quickly get to powerful cards like Karn, the Great Creator and All Is Dust. The deck includes strong control elements with cards like Devourer of Destiny and Kozilek's Command to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Additionally, cards like Expedition Map and Eldrazi Temple help ensure consistent mana sources for casting high-cost spells. The inclusion of cards like Boseiju, Who Endures and World Breaker provide additional utility and versatility in various matchups.

This deck focuses on aggressive plays with creatures like Guide of Souls, Amped Raptor, and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, backed up by burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Discharge. It also includes disruptive elements like Static Prison and Blood Moon to control the board. Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury provide additional threats, while Fable of the Mirror-Breaker can generate card advantage. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent quickly while utilizing the flexibility of the Boros colors for a versatile game plan.

This Mardu Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creatures and burn spells to quickly deal damage to the opponent. It also includes ways to sacrifice creatures for additional value and disruption through Goblin Bombardment. The deck also includes removal spells like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Overall, the key concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy while also having some control elements to disrupt the opponent's plan.

The deck focuses on aggressive creature plays and disruption, utilizing powerful cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Galvanic Discharge to quickly pressure the opponent. It also includes cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push for disruption and removal. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds additional flexibility to the deck. Overall, the strategy is to overwhelm the opponent with fast and efficient creatures while disrupting their game plan with removal and hand disruption spells.

The deck utilizes a toolbox of creatures to combo off and create powerful synergies. It focuses on tutoring for specific creatures with cards like Chord of Calling and Finale of Devastation while utilizing cards like Malevolent Rumble and Delighted Halfling for additional support. The deck also includes protection with cards like Sylvan Safekeeper and Venser, Shaper Savant. With a mix of mana ramp, creature tutoring, and protection, the deck aims to create a versatile and powerful board presence to overwhelm opponents in a Modern 1 vs 1 format.

The deck focuses on using various mill cards like Archive Trap, Fractured Sanity, Ruin Crab, and Tasha's Hideous Laughter to mill the opponent's library quickly. It also includes control elements like Counterspell and Supreme Verdict to protect the combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's strategy. Additional cards like Surgical Extraction and Path to Exile help to deal with key cards in the opponent's graveyard or battlefield. The deck aims to efficiently mill the opponent out while controlling the board to secure the win.

The deck revolves around cycling creatures like Street Wraith and Curator of Mysteries to fill the graveyard, then casting Living End to bring them all back onto the battlefield for a massive tempo swing. Cards like Ardent Plea and Shardless Agent help to cascade into Living End for free, while disruptive spells like Flare of Denial and Force of Negation protect the combo. The deck also utilizes powerful creatures like Endurance and Waker of Waves to disrupt the opponent's game plan while setting up its own combo.

This Eldrazi Aggro deck focuses on overwhelming the opponent with powerful Eldrazi creatures and control spells. By utilizing efficient creatures like Thought-Knot Seer and powerful spells like Ugin's Binding, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while quickly closing out the game with large threats like Emrakul, the Promised End and World Breaker. The deck also includes a variety of support cards like Malevolent Rumble and Kozilek's Command to further control the game and ensure victory through aggressive plays and strategic decision-making.
